<module id="fixed_point_adder">
    <description>A fixed-point adder module for performing arithmetic operations based on parameters Q and N.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">N-bit output representing the result of the fixed-point addition.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <!-- Parameter Description -->
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="Q">Number of fractional bits (precision).</param>
        <param id="N">Total number of bits, including integer and fractional parts.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <!-- Logic Description -->
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]">Register to hold the computed result of addition/subtraction.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <!-- Implementation Block -->
    <implementation>
        <assign c = (a[N-1] == b[N-1]) ? res : (~res + 1);
        
        // Perform absolute value addition if signs are the same
        always @(a or b) begin
            if(a[N-1]==b[N-1])
                res = (a[N-2:0]+b[N-2:0]);
            else if(a[N-1]>b[N-1]) begin
                // Perform subtraction if a > b
                res = (a[N-2:0]-b[N-2:0]);
                res[N-1]=1'd0;
            end
            else if(b[N-1]>a[N-1]) begin
                // Perform subtraction if b > a
                res = (b[N-2:0]-a[N-2:0]);
                res[N-1]=(res==0)?1'd0:(~(res)+1);
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
